name: leaky_relu_
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::leaky_relu_(Tensor(a!) self, Scalar negative_slope=0.01) -> Tensor(a!). Applies leaky ReLU in place, mutates self, and returns the same Tensor object and storage. Tests cover multiple negative slopes, floating dtypes, zero-sized and noncontiguous tensors, identity, and autograd through a non-leaf input.
